name: Psychotic Ink

has_own_site_check.result: Resolves but 302-redirects to a hugedomains.com "domain for sale" parking page. Confirmed personally per task brief. Not a real business site, just a squatted/expired domain listed for sale. (Note: the automated research_ig.py fallback flagged has_own_site true because it only checks that the domain resolves, not the redirect target -- overridden here per the pre-verified fact.)
has_own_site_check.conclusion: No live owned website. has_own_site = false, with the parked domain used as an honest outreach hook.

email_source: Not found after checking: research_ig.py/IG cloud service (degraded, could not see bio), TikTok bio, Facebook page (login-walled for About/posts paths), tattoomenu.com, superpages.com, inkfinder.tattoo listings. A WebSearch AI summary once surfaced "adamclwbch@gmail.com" but it could not be corroborated in any actual fetched source page, so it is treated as unverified and NOT used per the no-invented-data rule. outreach = pending_manual via phone/IG DM.

instagram.note: Primary real social channel per task brief. IG research via research_ig.py fell back to the cloud photo service which returned only 1 unusable UI-fragment image (research_degradado: true) -- IG itself resets all Playwright connections from this sandbox (verified: even a plain https://example.com goto fails with ERR_CONNECTION_RESET through the local proxy), so no local browser rescue was possible either.

tiktok.bio: Over 26 years of tattooing and piercings on Clearwater beach. walk-ins welcome.
tiktok.note: Small secondary channel, real. Found via WebSearch. Curl-fetched successfully (unlike Instagram) and yielded 3 clean, real, watermark-clean finished-tattoo cover images (turtle, frog, pelican) used in the gallery/hero.

facebook.note: 3982 likes per search snippet. Video post pages (facebook.com/<id>/videos/...) are fetchable logged-out and yielded 2 more real photos (shark hand tattoo, floral sleeve with real storefront signage) after cropping out a TikTok repost watermark that sat in a non-content margin of the frame. Facebook 'posts'/'photos' paths and the page root return HTTP 400 logged-out; Yelp returns 403; Google Maps and archive.org are JS-only/blocked in this sandbox.

rating_source: https://www.localtattoos.com/florida/clearwater/psychotic-ink/ (aggregates Google), re-fetched directly and confirmed verbatim: 4.7 stars, 574 reviews. Matches the pre-verified figure in the task brief exactly. Yelp separately shows its own count (57 reviews on Yelp specifically, yelp.com/biz/psychotic-ink-clearwater-beach, 403 to direct fetch so not used for quotes).

hours.source: localtattoos.com and superpages.com both independently confirm 11:30am open, matching task brief exactly.

since_note: Task brief verified fact, used as-is. Note found in the wild: the shop's own logo graphic reads 'EST. 1996' and the TikTok bio says 'over 26 years' (~2000); these are minor real-world inconsistencies common to old small businesses. Site copy uses the pre-verified '1998' and avoids stating a specific year-count to sidestep the drift.
artists_note: Task brief listed Adam, Dustin, Aaron, Levi. Fresh research (2026-07 reviews ~10-11 months old, TikTok captions/bio) repeatedly and recently corroborates Adam, Dustin and Aaron by name. Levi was NOT found in any fresh source (reviews, TikTok, Facebook, search) during this pass, so per instructions not to assume staff are unchanged, Levi is omitted from the site rather than assumed current.

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: Tess Muir
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: My friend and I walked in and were taken care of right away. We had a great experience! We told them what we wanted and Aaron picked out a stencil for us and gave us the vision he had for our tattoo. Very clean and welcoming location. We were very pleased for Aaron to ensure that we see him take fresh needles out of the packaging. Highly recommend!

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: Wesley Grieger
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: Adam did an awesome job! Made the whole process very easy! Only problem is that I need to book a flight down to Florida to get my next tattoo! Turned out better than I expected!

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: Ashley Begley
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: Awesome fine line work with attention to detail. Ask for Dustin. Support your local business. This place is the only place to get tattooed on Clearwater Beach. Down to earth, kind local artists and great prices!

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: Kanisa Tucker
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: me and my sister got matching tattoos. Adam was great super nice and very very very quick! They are great and our tattoos were $70 each. They also have $60 wall too

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: D Petrone
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: I had a tattoo design I made and wanted to get it for years. Got it done by Dustin and it is better than I could have imagined. He was also able to fix a tattoo had a messed up letter from another studio up north and you cant even tell the old one was there

reviews_pulled_verbatim.author: Robin Hoffman
reviews_pulled_verbatim.quote: 3rd times a charm AT PSYCHOTIC INK!! Professional friendly FUN & they scheduled & successfully tatted my crazy request - permanent EARRINGS INTO MY LOBES!! Thank You Dustin Jackson!! I WILL RETURN!!

photos_used.source_breakdown: 3 from TikTok @psychotic.ink video cover frames (turtle, frog, pelican -- clean, no watermark, originCover field), 2 from Facebook video-post og:image (shark hand tattoo, floral sleeve tattoo with real storefront signage reading '...TATTOO...BODY PIERCING...0968' visible in frame) each manually cropped with PIL to remove a TikTok-repost watermark that sat in a black-bar/background margin outside the actual tattoo content, not over it.
photos_used.logo: assets/raw/logo.jpg, the shop's own real vintage-style logo graphic pulled from its TikTok avatar.
photos_used.curation_note: All 5 are finished, healed, clean tattoo photos: no blood, no mid-procedure shots, no captions baked into the kept crops, no artist selfies. This meets but does not exceed the 5-photo minimum; more could not be sourced because Instagram is unreachable from this sandbox (ERR_CONNECTION_RESET at the network level, confirmed even for https://example.com) and the cloud IG photo fallback service is currently returning garbage (1 unusable UI-fragment image) for every handle tested, not just this one.
